lenses.lens: emailProviderConfigured=true when a key is present — overclaim?

It enables nothing — real sending requires EMAIL_RUNTIME_MODE=live + EMAIL_SEND_LIVE=true + paid customer, independent of this flag. readyForProductionActivation requires emailProviderConfigured AND emailDomainVerified AND 12 more external proofs. Documented in the env contract + provider matrix reports.

Refactored to a clean deterministic 3-way: PARTIAL (local prep incomplete) / PREPARATION_VERIFIED (local done, external blockers remain) / LOCALLY_VERIFIED (local done, all external blockers resolved, production not yet activated). All three reachable; current state → PREPARATION_VERIFIED. tsc 0, 43/43 still green.
